notablePrerequisites: You have at least one +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Rosie Cotton of South Lane triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and any other creature you control due to Doubling Season.
When the Oozes enters the battlefield, Sigil Captain triggers twice, putting four +1/+1 counters on each of them due to Doubling Season.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.
